title: Annual Sports Day 2026
description: Join us for an exciting day of sports competitions, including athletics, football, cricket, and more. Prizes for winners!

title: Science Fair 2026
description: Students will showcase innovative science projects. Open to all classes. Judges from local universities will evaluate projects.

title: Cultural Program - Independence Day
description: Cultural performances including songs, dances, drama, and poetry recitation celebrating Independence Day.

title: Parent-Teacher Meeting
description: Discuss student progress, academic performance, and future plans with teachers. All parents are encouraged to attend.

title: Inter-School Debate Competition
description: Students from 5 schools will compete in English and Bangla debate. Topics will be announced on the day.
